scope: Primary sources used in article development; this ledger reproduces the final article source list and its claim mapping. Native observations are separate in native-output.txt.

article_source_list.claim_scope: PostgreSQL 18, Introduction to Indexes, Multicolumn Indexes and Indexes and ORDER BY: the saved searches, leading equalities, range bounds, skip scan and early stopping.
PostgreSQL 18, Combining Multiple Indexes and Using EXPLAIN: bitmap page order, estimated work and actual row and buffer counts.
PostgreSQL 18, Index-Only Scans and Covering Indexes, Partial Indexes and Indexes on Expressions: the extra eligibility conditions and maintenance costs.
PostgreSQL 18, Constraints, Heap-Only Tuples and B-Tree Indexes: automatically created unique indexes, referencing-column indexes, updates and tree pages.
MySQL 8.4, Clustered and Secondary Indexes: why a secondary entry carries a primary key in InnoDB.
